He meant 'I heard' but used the present; she said 'I heard' and he switched to سمعت.
Plain present needs b-; her chat writes bey5awwef, she voiced nothing.

agreed.amal_said: No. At me. ... At. تطلع علي.

agreed.amal_said: No. Don't look. We're using تتطلع.

agreed.amal_said: اشرحيني is like explain me. اشرحيني. So اشرحيلي is.
agreed.why: 'to me' goes on li- (shara7 la-); she said اشرحيني means 'explain me' and gave اشرحيلي.

'My fiancee and I' need the plural adjective; she said 'plural' and he gave mishtahazine (engine for mish jaahzeen).
After jaahzeen (ready to) the verb drops b-; said at 54:59 and 56:17, she recast نصير at 56:18 and he took it.

He dropped la- again after her 55:33 fix; she prompted لا؟ and he said بنخطط لـ عرس (a new slip per GR-32).
